document.title: The First Turn - fixed-tool contact (authored candidate)
document.tone: Quiet observation grows into a shared decision.

continuity_locks: The tool remains on the workbench.
Actor marks and outfits remain fixed.
The final hand reaches the tool; no grasp, transfer or screw turn is simulated.
visual_style.lighting: Soft warm workshop preview; qualify actual light separately.
visual_style.palette: Rust visitor outfit, dark maker outfit and a neutral workbench.
visual_style.sound: Quiet workshop room tone. No generated or recorded sound is part of this rehearsal.
visual_style.visual_rules: One workshop and one fixed tool. Establish attention, invitation, decision, then contact.
visual_style.wardrobe: Visitor in rust, maker in dark blue. Persistent outfits across every shot.

context.tone: Quiet observation grows into a shared decision.

adaptation: The original proposed handoff is replaced explicitly with a waiting fixed tool and an invitation gesture.
